scaled_pdb_tokenization_cameo.description: Protein backbone structure tokenization on the scaled CAMEO held-out split. Reference values use two reported structural-tokenizer operating points from the paper's Table 16.
scaled_pdb_tokenization_cameo.notes: RMSD, lDDT, BPR, and vocabulary size are copied from the paper's Table 16 rows. The benchmark computes BPR as a reproducible encoded-token proxy, so reproduced BPR is not expected to match the paper's full description-length BPR exactly.

rmsd.description: Primary geometric reconstruction error between original and reconstructed backbone coordinates.

lddt.description: Local distance preservation score that rewards reconstructed backbones with native-like local geometry.

bpr.description: Encoded-token bits-per-residue proxy that penalizes inefficient structural encodings.

vocab_size.description: Vocabulary compactness constraint that discourages memorizing structures with an unbounded token set.
